entities.summary: Cristian Ignacio Garín Medone is a Chilean professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 17 achieved on 13 September 2021 and a best doubles ranking of No. 206 reached on 10 May 2021. He is currently the No. 2 singles player from Chile.
